Document: Practice Direction 51ZF – Part 3 of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021: provision during piloted commencement
Part 3 of 3
==================================================
Notifying the police when a DAPO is served or P is informed of its terms

## 21.1 This paragraph applies where P has been—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.1 This paragraph applies where P has been—] (a) served with a DAPO; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.1 This paragraph applies where P has been—] (b) informed of the terms of a DAPO (whether by being present when the order was made or by telephone or otherwise). ## 21.2 Where—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.2 Where—] (a) paragraph 21.1(a) applies, a certificate of service; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.2 Where—] (b) paragraph 21.1(b) applies, a notification,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.2 Where—] must be sent by email to the police force to which the DAPO was sent. ## 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] (a)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] (b) the applicant’s representative, where the applicant is represented; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] (c) the court officer, where the applicant is acting in person. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] 21.4 Where paragraph 21.3(b) applies the email notification to the police must be sent within 2 days of P being served with, or informed of the terms of, the DAPO. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] 21.5 Where paragraph 21.3(c) applies, the email notification to the police must be sent within 1 day of receipt by the court officer of confirmation of service, or of P having been informed of the terms of the DAPO, from the court bailiff. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] 21.6 Where a DAPO is varied or discharged, this paragraph applies in relation to notification to the police of—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] (a) service of the order varying or discharging the DAPO; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] (b) P being informed of—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] (i) the terms of the DAPO as varied; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] (ii) the discharge of the DAPO,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] as it applies to notification to the police of service of the DAPO or P being informed of its terms. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 21.3 The email notification must be sent by—] 21.7 This paragraph does not apply where the DAPO states that the court has dispensed with the need for service of the order, because the court is satisfied that P is aware of the terms of the DAPO without the need for such service to be effected. ## IX — VARIATION OR DISCHARGE OF A DAPO

## 22. Variation or discharge of a DAPO made by the court

## 22.1 The relevant provisions of paragraphs 3, 4 and 6 to 19 apply to—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.1 The relevant provisions of paragraphs 3, 4 and 6 to 19 apply to—] (a) an application to vary or discharge a DAPO; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.1 The relevant provisions of paragraphs 3, 4 and 6 to 19 apply to—] (b) service of any variation or discharge of a DAPO,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.1 The relevant provisions of paragraphs 3, 4 and 6 to 19 apply to—] as they apply to an application for a DAPO and service of a DAPO. ## 22.2 An application to vary a DAPO may be made without notice to P. ## 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (a) may be made by—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (i) the person to be protected;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (ii) P;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (iii)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (iv) the chief officer of police of the force maintained for any police area in which P resides; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (v) the chief officer of police of any other force maintained for a police area who believes that P is in that police area or is intending to come to it;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (b) must be made using Form N244, supported by a witness statement and set out—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (i) whether the applicant is aware whether there is a relevant chief officer of police who wishes to be heard in accordance with section 44(4)(a) of the 2021 Act; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (ii) if the application is made by the person to be protected and seeks to discharge the order, or to remove or make less onerous any requirement imposed by the order, the reasons for making the application; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.3 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO—] (c) must be emailed by the court officer to the relevant chief officer of police when the application is issued together with a request for confirmation as to whether they wish to be heard. ## 22.4 The court may vary or discharge a DAPO—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.4 The court may vary or discharge a DAPO—] (a)  on application by a person detailed in paragraph 22.3(a); or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.4 The court may vary or discharge a DAPO—] (b) of its own initiative in any case in which it could make a DAPO under section 31(7) of the 2021 Act. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.4 The court may vary or discharge a DAPO—] 22.5 Where practicable, within one day of the notification under paragraph 22.3(c), the relevant chief officer of police must confirm to the court whether they wish to be heard and if so, to provide their evidence to the court in writing. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.4 The court may vary or discharge a DAPO—] 22.6 The written evidence that the relevant chief officer of police wishes to provide must be submitted to the court within the period of time specified by the court. ## 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] (a) where there is a relevant chief officer of police who wishes to be heard, the court has heard from that relevant chief officer of police; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] (b) if the application is made by the person to be protected and seeks to discharge the order, or to remove or make less onerous any requirement imposed by the order, the court has heard from that person. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] 22.8 Where the court is considering whether to vary or discharge a DAPO of its own initiative, it must first—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] (a) ascertain, in accordance with paragraph 22.9, whether there is a relevant chief officer of police who wishes to be heard; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] (b) if so, hear from that relevant chief officer of police, in writing. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] 22.9 The court officer must email the relevant chief officer of police requesting confirmation as to whether they wish to be heard and the relevant chief officer of police must respond to the request in accordance with paragraph 22.5. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] 22.10   Where the court varies or discharges a DAPO of its own initiative, paragraphs 12.2 (court may direct a hearing to consider any representations), 13 (general) and 16 (DAPOs made by the court in existing relevant proceedings) apply. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] 22.11 Where a DAPO is varied or discharged under this paragraph and the variation or discharge relates to—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] (a) a positive requirement included in the DAPO; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] (b) an electronic requirement imposed in the DAPO,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.7 An application to vary or discharge a DAPO shall not be determined by the court until—] the court officer must notify the responsible person of the variation or discharge, as the case may be. ## 22.12

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.12] 22.13 In this paragraph, “relevant chief officer of police” has the meaning given by section 44(5) of the 2021 Act. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 22.12] (Any application to vary or discharge a DAPO must be made to the court that made the order (section 45(1)). A court may vary or discharge a DAPO made by any other court of its own initiative.)

## X — ENFORCEMENT

## 23. Application for issue of warrant for arrest

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23. Application for issue of warrant for arrest] 23.1 An application under section 40(3) of the 2021 Act for the issue of a warrant for the arrest of P—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23. Application for issue of warrant for arrest] (a) may be made by—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23. Application for issue of warrant for arrest] (i) the person to be protected; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23. Application for issue of warrant for arrest] (ii)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23. Application for issue of warrant for arrest] (iii) any other person who has been granted permission of the relevant judge to apply under section 40(4)(c) of the 2021 Act; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23. Application for issue of warrant for arrest] (b) must include a copy of the DAPO which P has allegedly breached and be supported by a sworn statement. ## 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] (a) the reasons for making the application on behalf of the person to be protected; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] (b) the applicant’s connection with the person to be protected. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] 23.3 As soon as practicable after receiving an application under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii), the court must—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] (a) grant the application; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] (b) fix a date for the hearing of the application for permission. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] 23.4 The court officer must inform the following persons of the court’s action under paragraph 23.3—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] (a) the applicant;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] (b) the person to be protected (if that person is not the applicant); and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] (c) any other person directed by the court. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] 23.5 In this paragraph, “the relevant judge” has the meaning given by section 40(8)(c) of the 2021 Act. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 23.2 An application for permission under paragraph 23.1(a)(iii) must set out—] (Section 40 of the 2021 Act provides that where the DAPO was made by the county court, the application must be made to a judge of that court.)

## 24. Proceedings following arrest

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 24. Proceedings following arrest] 24.1 This paragraph applies where P is arrested pursuant to a warrant of arrest issued on an application under section 40(3) of the 2021 Act. ## 24.2 The relevant court before whom P is brought following arrest may—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 24.2 The relevant court before whom P is brought following arrest may—] (a)  determine whether the facts and the circumstances which led to P’s arrest amount to breach of the DAPO; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 24.2 The relevant court before whom P is brought following arrest may—] (b) adjourn the proceedings. ## 24.3 Where the proceedings are adjourned, P may be released and must—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 24.3 Where the proceedings are adjourned, P may be released and must—] (a) unless the court directs otherwise, be dealt with within 14 days of the day on which P was arrested; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 24.3 Where the proceedings are adjourned, P may be released and must—] (b) be given not less than 2 days’ notice of the adjourned hearing. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 24.3 Where the proceedings are adjourned, P may be released and must—] 24.4 An application notice seeking P’s committal for contempt of court may be issued if P is not dealt with within the period specified in paragraph 24.3(a). ## 24.5 In this paragraph, “relevant court” has the meaning given by section 40(2) of the 2021 Act. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 24.5 In this paragraph, “relevant court” has the meaning given by section 40(2) of the 2021 Act.] (The powers of the court to remand P are contained in section 40 of and Schedule 1 to the 2021 Act.)

## 25. Enforcement of orders

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 25. Enforcement of orders] 25.1 At the time when the order is drawn up, the court officer will, where the order made is (or includes) a DAPO, issue a copy of the order, endorsed with or incorporating a notice as to the consequences of breach, for service in accordance with Chapter VII. ## 25.2 Part 81 applies where an application is made to commit P for breach of an order. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 25.2 Part 81 applies where an application is made to commit P for breach of an order.] (Rule 81.4(2) sets out the information to be contained in a contempt application in relation to breach of an order.)

## 26. Power to adjourn the contempt hearing for consideration of the penalty

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 26. Power to adjourn the contempt hearing for consideration of the penalty] 26.1 The court may adjourn the hearing of a contempt application for consideration of the penalty to be imposed for any contempt of court found proved and such hearing may be restored if the contemnor does not comply with any conditions specified by the court. ## 27. Hospital orders under the Mental Health Act 1983

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 27. Hospital orders under the Mental Health Act 1983] 27.1 Where the court makes a hospital order under the Mental Health Act 1983, the court officer must—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 27. Hospital orders under the Mental Health Act 1983] (a) send to the hospital any information which will be of assistance in dealing with the patient; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 27. Hospital orders under the Mental Health Act 1983] (b) inform the persons directed by the court to be informed about when the patient is being transferred to hospital. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 27. Hospital orders under the Mental Health Act 1983] (Section 40 of the 2021 Act contains provision about the court’s power to remand P following arrest for breach of a DAPO. Schedule 1 to the 2021 Act sets out further provision about remand including the court’s power to remand for the purpose of enabling a medical examination to take place and the power to make an order under section 35 of the Mental Health Act 1983 (remand to hospital for report on mental condition).)

## 28. Transfer directions under section 48 of the Mental Health Act 1983

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 28. Transfer directions under section 48 of the Mental Health Act 1983] 28.1 Where a transfer direction given by the Secretary of State under section 48 of the Mental Health Act 1983 is in force in respect of a person remanded in custody by the court, the court officer must notify—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 28. Transfer directions under section 48 of the Mental Health Act 1983] (a) the governor of the prison to which that person was remanded; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 28. Transfer directions under section 48 of the Mental Health Act 1983] (b) the hospital where that person is detained,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 28. Transfer directions under section 48 of the Mental Health Act 1983] of any committal hearing which that person is required to attend. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 28. Transfer directions under section 48 of the Mental Health Act 1983] 28.2 The court officer must also give notice in writing of any further remand to the hospital where that person is detained. ## 29. Recognizances

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 29. Recognizances] 29.1 Where, in accordance with paragraph 2(3)(b) of Schedule 1 to the 2021 Act, the court fixes the amount of any recognizance with a view to it being taken subsequently, the recognizance may be taken by—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 29. Recognizances] (a) a judge of the court;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 29. Recognizances] (b) a police officer of the rank of inspector or above or in charge of a police station; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 29. Recognizances] (c) the governor or keeper of a prison where the arrested person is in the custody of that governor or keeper. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 29. Recognizances] 29.2 The person having custody of an applicant for bail must release the applicant for bail if satisfied that the required recognizances have been taken. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 51ZF – PART 3 OF THE DOMESTIC ABUSE ACT 2021: PROVISION DURING PILOTED COMMENCEMENT > 29. Recognizances] Updated: Thursday, 13 February 2025
